    Lemma 12.3: gr_𝔪 B ≅ C #

    lem:flat-mesh-perturbations (deformation-refinements.tex): "Then gr_𝔪 B ≅ C." In each degree d, paths induce a linear isomorphism from C_d(w, y) (the image of the degree-d paths in C) onto 𝔪^d B(w, y)/𝔪^{d+1} B(w, y) (grIso); composition is induced by composition of paths on both sides. The map is well defined since a homogeneous relation u r v of degree d is u (r − f) v + u f v with u f v ∈ 𝔪^{d+1} (hctx_le_B_succ), onto since paths of length > d lie in 𝔪^{d+1} (sub_proj_mem_geSpan_succ), and bijective by counting: the degree projections make C graded (πC), so Σ_d dim C_d ≤ dim C, while Σ_d dim gr^d B = dim B = dim C (Lemma 12.3's dimension equality).
